old_problem: MMHUB target mapping, fatal envelope, durable evidence and recovery were unspecified; raw HTTP/max-ID and clearing could lose causality. DeepSeek omitted d0/b3/s0/t4 and ext59/GfxMmhubError.
disposition_reason: The source command and MMHUB fatal oracle are complete. ED-15/16 permit physical mapping, compatible package/schema, isolated window, persistent evidence and recovery as mandatory no-go runtime gates. Review resolution preserves MMHUB-specific translation/final-health proof and authorizes no injection.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2081, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2082 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00126-V003 / 5a16a3c8f2ff41d7 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
d0/b3/s0/t4 plus OAM/MMHUB/ext59/GfxMmhubError/fatal define command and result; mapping is a signed prerequisite.
MMHUB affects GPU memory translation and can eliminate in-band access, so durable OOB evidence, console chronology and recovered translation/GPU health are independent acceptance dimensions.
Complete authenticated pre/post CPER entry sets and attachment hashes replace maximum-ID inference and retain collateral events.
One injection only on isolated non-production hardware; stop outside the fatal envelope and never substitute GC, SDMA or XGMI evidence.
No injection, amdgpuras, Redfish/CPER, crash/reboot/power action, recovery, log clear, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: One-shot fatal MMHUB injection with ext59 CPER, translation-health and recovery proof
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved uncorrectable MMHUB fault and prove controlled fatal/recovery behavior plus OOB/surviving in-band CPER identify mapped OAM, MMHUB, ext59 GfxMmhubError and fatal severity, followed by healthy memory-translation and GPU state.
required_package: Signed AMD/FAE d0/b3/s0/t4 physical MMHUB map and fatal state/event contract
Dedicated non-production SUT, one-shot approval, persistent evidence and rehearsed console/power recovery
Authenticated paginated CPER access and secure storage
Post-recovery MMHUB/translation, GPU enumeration, memory access and platform-health oracle
test_case.test_command: FATAL RAS GATE CLOSED. Preserve durable OOB/in-band/MMHUB/GPU baselines; after recovery rehearsal and point approval execute exactly once `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 3 -s 0 -t 4`. Capture fatal console/power timeline, recover only through the signed path, enumerate/hash/decode all causal CPER, reconcile available -C, then validate MMHUB translation and GPU memory-access health. No clear, max-ID/plaintext shortcut, other-bank substitution or retry.
test_case.expected_result: One approved action produces the signed fatal/recovery sequence and causal CPER reporting mapped OAM, MMHUB, ext59 GfxMmhubError and fatal severity; available in-band evidence agrees and post-recovery translation/GPU/platform health is clean.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the approved block-3 MMHUB target, one d0/b3/s0/t4 action, causal ext59 GfxMmhubError fatal artifacts, recovered GPU enumeration and validated MMHUB translation/memory access. FAIL on wrong bank, missing/wrong MMHUB event, translation or GPU-memory defect, recovery breach, collateral event or evidence gap. Unsigned prerequisites are NOT READY.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until MMHUB mapping, isolated SUT, durable evidence and recovery are signed/rehearsed.
One fatal action only with explicit point approval; expect in-band loss.
No clear, other-bank substitution or retry; preserve first evidence.
Quarantine on uncertain translation, GPU enumeration or final state.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed MMHUB map/version/fatal/recovery contract
Paginated CPER raw/hash/decode and available in-band reconciliation
OAM/MMHUB/ext59/GfxMmhubError/fatal matrix plus post translation/memory health
test_case.recovery: On unexpected fatal behavior, control loss, wrong MMHUB event, translation failure or deadline breach, stop and preserve evidence. Do not inject, clear or automatically power-cycle. Use only rehearsed vendor recovery, quarantine uncertain GPU/SUT state and require owner release.
